cues.text: Did you know how many push-ups you
should be able to do based on your age?
Let's find out. If you're around 10
years old, hitting 5 to 10 clean
push-ups is already solid. At 15, you
should be aiming for 15 to 20, enough to
be stronger than most kids your age. At
20, the target jumps to 25 to 40
push-ups. [music] This is when your body
is near its physical peak. In your 30s,
20 to 35 clean push-ups is still a great
sign of upper body strength. At 50,
hitting 10 to 20 push-ups is genuinely
impressive. Most people stop training
long before that. And if you're over 60
and can still do 5 to 15 clean push-ups,
you're doing better than a lot of
younger people. Remember, a perfect
push-up counts more than 50 bad ones.
Now, be honest, how old are you and how
many push-ups can you do right now?

text: Did you know how many push-ups you should be able to do based on your age? Let's find out. If you're around 10 years old, hitting 5 to 10 clean push-ups is already solid. At 15, you should be aiming for 15 to 20, enough to be stronger than most kids your age. At 20, the target jumps to 25 to 40 push-ups. [music] This is when your body is near its physical peak. In your 30s, 20 to 35 clean push-ups is still a great sign of upper body strength. At 50, hitting 10 to 20 push-ups is genuinely impressive. Most people stop training long before that. And if you're over 60 and can still do 5 to 15 clean push-ups, you're doing better than a lot of younger people. Remember, a perfect push-up counts more than 50 bad ones. Now, be honest, how old are you and how many push-ups can you do right now?
